scenarios.name: Collapse and expands the origin branch

scenario_steps.name: an active part in the MCAD Software contains a visible solid and has a visible model browser
the branch shows three origin planes, three origin axes and a center point
the user clicks the Origin branch expansion control
the solid remains visible in the viewport
the user clicks the Origin branch expansion control again
the origin planes, axes and center point are visible again
the solid remains in the same apparent view
